text:
alex: planning a microkernel + quant swap (quant-kernel:4.2 -> 4.3) in the 01:30 UTC quiet window. tiny-slice 5% initially, hold buckets thermal-3 for 15m.

joel: I’ll run smoke (5 short gens + matmul microbench). pass if p99 < baseline+25% and errs <0.5%. script: `curl -s -X POST https://staging-infer/api/v1/generate -d '{\"model\":\"quant-kernel:4.3\"}'`

priya: eval T+10m: top-8 prompts, rollback if any prompt >3% regression.

nate: infra thresholds: GPU temp <79C, node mem <85%, OoM=0. If node-level mem >85% isolate and pin.

deploybot: swap queued. swap-id=sw-20240612-07. pin cmd: `/deploy pin engine=quant-kernel:4.2 ttl=6h reason="night-safety"`

~swap started~

joel: post-swap quick: global p99 +18%, errs 0.2%. node-bk-11 shows mem 87% and p99 spike.

nate: isolating node-bk-11 and draining.

alex: pin node and exclude from routing, do NOT rollback globally.

deploybot: `/deploy pin engine=quant-kernel:4.2 ttl=12h target=node-bk-11 reason="mem-pressure"`

priya: T+10m eval: one prompt regressed 2.1% < threshold. no OoM.

docs: pushed release note draft + pin-by-node example.

alex: promoting to 20% after T+20m if stable. leaving node-bk-11 pinned 12h. good job team :thumbsup:
